items.q: Find the volume of a cylinder of radius 3 cm and height 10 cm.
Find the surface area of a cylinder of radius 4 cm and height 5 cm.
hints: Use total SA = 2πr^2 + 2πrh (two circular ends plus the curved side).

items.q: Find the volume of a sphere of radius 6 cm.
Find the volume of a prism with cross-sectional area 12 cm^2 and length 8 cm.
hints: Use V = cross-sectional area x length.

items.q: Find the curved surface area of a cylinder of radius 7 cm and height 9 cm.
hints: Use curved SA = 2πrh (just the side, no end caps).

items.q: Find the surface area of a sphere of radius 5 cm.
A solid is made from a cylinder of volume 50pi and a hemisphere of volume 18pi. Find the total volume.
A cuboid has volume 120 cm^3 and a cylinder hole of volume 15pi cm^3 is removed. Find the remaining volume.
hints: Subtract the removed volume from the total.

items.q: A prism of volume 72 cm^3 is joined to a cube of volume 27 cm^3. Find the total volume.
A cylinder of volume 81pi cm^3 has a cone of volume 21pi cm^3 removed. Find the remaining volume.
hints: Subtract the removed volume from the total.

items.q: Two spheres each have volume 36pi cm^3. Find the combined volume.
hints: Add the two equal volumes together.

items.q: A hemisphere of volume 144pi cm^3 is joined to a cylinder of volume 80pi cm^3. Find the total volume.
A cylinder of radius 4 cm and height 9 cm has a cone of the same radius and height removed from one end. Find the remaining volume.
hints: Find the cylinder's volume and the cone's volume separately, then subtract.
